{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the data structure
print(trial_df.info())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:\n', trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nDuplicate rows:', trial_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check unique values in 'site' column
print('\nUnique sites:', trial_df['site'].unique())

# Check response rate by site
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('site')['response'].mean() * 100
print('\nResponse rates by site:\n', response_rates)"}
